Package game.positions.area

Class ItemDropper

java.lang.Object
game.positions.area.ItemDropper
public class ItemDropper extends Object
Moves Items onto, and off, the tiles of an Area.

  • Method Details

    • dropOnRandomTile

      public Optional<Location> dropOnRandomTile(Item item)
      Places the given Item on a randomly chosen tile of the area. Does nothing if the area has no tiles.
      Parameters:
      item - the Item to place
      Returns:
      the tile the Item was placed on, or empty if the area has no tiles

    • placeOnEveryTile

      public void placeOnEveryTile(ItemFactory factory)
      Places a freshly created Item, from the given factory, on every tile of the area. A new Item is constructed for each tile, so no two tiles ever share the same Item instance.
      Parameters:
      factory - produces one new Item per tile

    • liftAll

      public List<Item> liftAll()
      Removes every Item lying on the tiles of the area.
      Returns:
      the Items that were removed, in tile order

    • dropAllCarriedBy

      public List<Item> dropAllCarriedBy(Actor actor)
      Removes every Item the given Actor is carrying and places each one on a randomly chosen tile of the area.
      Parameters:
      actor - the Actor whose inventory is emptied
      Returns:
      the Items that were dropped, in the order they were carried
